claims.claim_text: An exact-name Army enlisted candidate for Woon S Chung remains in the private review system.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army merged file contains one Woon S Chung entry dated 9 June 1943 at private grade, while the index prints 1st Lt. and no identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact name is distinctive, but no private identifier, hometown, birth datum, unit or personnel-file bridge connects the Army entry to the indexed lieutenant.
claims.temporal_assessment: The dates could permit later commissioning, but no promotion or OSS-entry chronology has been established.
claims.match_notes: The rank difference is not silently reconciled. No Army occupation or enlisted classification is transferred to the indexed person.

claims.claim_text: Archie Chun-Ming has a high-confidence match to the CIA's documented Army physician and OSS Detachment 101 officer.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Army Medical Corps Captain Archie Chun-Ming
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Two CIA institutional sources identify the distinctive exact name as a Hawaii-born physician, Army captain and original Detachment 101 member recruited in spring 1942.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Distinctive exact full name, direct OSS context, profession, Army status, Hawaii setting and recruitment chronology; no contradictory candidate found. Assessed high confidence because no service-number bridge was located.
claims.temporal_assessment: The institutional sources date recruitment to spring 1942 and describe later Detachment 101 service.
claims.match_notes: The private index number is masked and was absent from the Army enlisted merged file. The source-supported Captain classification is retained without changing the index's blank rank field.

claims.claim_text: Archie Chun-Ming was recruited into COI from an unidentified Army reserve unit in Hawaii in spring 1942.
claims.evidence_excerpt: recruited from a reserve unit in Hawaii in the spring of 1942
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The CIA historical article explicitly places Chun-Ming in a Hawaii reserve unit immediately before recruitment into the organization that became OSS.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive exact name, Army captain status, physician role and Detachment 101 context establish a high-confidence identity match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit immediate language: recruited from the reserve unit in spring 1942.
claims.match_notes: The reserve unit is not named. This is a military assignment, not a civilian employer, and COI recruitment is treated as the entry into the OSS predecessor organization.

claims.claim_text: Archie Chun-Ming practiced medicine in Honolulu before wartime recruitment.
claims.evidence_excerpt: after graduation Archie came back to practice medicine in his hometown
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The CIA biography states that he returned to Honolulu after medical school and practiced medicine before the 1942 recruitment chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive exact name and integrated OSS biography establish a high-confidence match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Definitely prewar, but the evidence does not establish exact practice dates or whether this was his last civilian work before active military service.
claims.match_notes: No clinic, hospital, employer or ownership arrangement is named. The claim is occupation and location only, not self-employment or a last civilian employer.

claims.claim_text: Archie Chun-Ming served as president of the Hawaii Chinese Civic Association in June 1941.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The CIA biography explicitly identifies his June 1941 presidency and community-organizing role.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive exact name and integrated OSS biography establish a high-confidence match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly dated June 1941, before spring 1942 recruitment; tenure boundaries are not given.
claims.match_notes: The association role is not treated as employment, and the source does not establish compensation.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 81 context and complete Army bulk comparison; exact-name and punctuated-variant OSS/CIA searches; lieutenant, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, Library of Congress newspaper and archival-source searches for Woon S Chung.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Modern donor, property and professional-license results concern later people; a 1950s agricultural author lacks an OSS or military bridge. The exact-name Army private lacks a second corroborating identifier and conflicts with the index's printed lieutenant rank.
research_attempts.research_notes: A later promotion is possible but unproved. The Army occupation and enlisted category remain withheld pending Box 124 evidence.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 124 for a service identifier, unit history and promotion chronology before resolving the exact-name candidate.
